# fjordrun_volume (Resource)

A service's persistent volume in one environment (one per service and environment). Plans limit the size.

~> **Data loss is permanent.** Destroying a volume, or anything that replaces it (changing `mount_path`, `service_id` or `environment_id`), deletes the data, with no way back. So does destroying its service, environment or project. Volumes are bound to the location they were created in: the project's region can't change while it has volumes. Protect them:

```terraform
lifecycle {
  prevent_destroy = true
}
```

A new volume is mounted at once (or at the next deployment with `auto_deploy = false`). Volumes can only grow: a smaller `size_gb` is refused at plan time. Destroying a volume always restarts a running service, because its workload has to be recreated without the volume.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "team_id" {
  type = string
}

resource "fjordrun_project" "shop" {
  team_id = var.team_id
  name    = "shop"
}

resource "fjordrun_service" "web" {
  project_id     = fjordrun_project.shop.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_project.shop.default_environment_id
  name           = "web"
  source         = { type = "image", image = "nginxdemos/hello:0.4" }
}

resource "fjordrun_volume" "uploads" {
  service_id     = fjordrun_service.web.id
  environment_id = fjordrun_service.web.environment_id
  mount_path     = "/data"
  size_gb        = 10

  lifecycle {
    # destroying a volume deletes its data, for good
    prevent_destroy = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID.
- `mount_path` (String) Absolute path to mount the volume at. **Changing it replaces the volume and deletes its data.**
- `service_id` (String) Service ID.

### Optional

- `auto_deploy` (Boolean) Deploy when this resource is created or changes. Leave out to use the provider's `auto_deploy` (default `true`). With `false` the change is saved and goes live with the next deployment, which `fjordrun_deployment` makes explicit.
- `size_gb` (Number) Size in GB (default 5). Can only grow.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time.
- `id` (String) Volume ID.
- `name` (String) Volume name.
- `used_mb` (Number) Space in use, in MB.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# service_id/environment_id
terraform import fjordrun_volume.uploads 77777777-7777-7777-7777-777777777777/66666666-6666-6666-6666-666666666666
```
